steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Configure the event as an RFQ with whole-lot awarding.
Provide the required event title so the create flow is valid.
Choose the available RFQ pricing template.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Confirm the product was added before opening Participants.
Verify that the All Vendors window opened.
Cancel the Participants window without applying changes.
Verify that the All Vendors window closed.
Verify that cancelling leaves the buyer on the single-stage create screen.
Verify that cancelling did not remove or alter the configured product.
